resources.string: Checking Root and Shizuku. Actions will be offered in this order: Root, Shizuku, then manual restart.
Found su, but Root access for this module is unconfirmed. Authorization alone will not restart Bilibili.
Root access was recently confirmed. Tap to save and restart; access will be checked again before execution.
The last attempt did not obtain Root access. Check your Root manager and retry, or use Shizuku or manual restart.
No usable su was found. Check again, or use Shizuku or manual restart.
The Root check did not finish or encountered an error. Check again or choose another method.
Use Root first to force stop and reopen Bilibili. If Root is unavailable, use Shizuku; manual restart from app details is the final fallback. Your current configuration will be saved first.
Use Shizuku to force stop and reopen Bilibili, or restart manually from app details. Your current configuration will be saved first.
